dependencies.description: LEASEBIL reads COOLFLAG.DAT to determine chiller outage status for SLA billing penalty calculation.
BMS export job exports chiller cooling status flags to COOLFLAG.DAT.
CAMCALC shares lease record layout copybook with LEASEBIL.
LEASEBIL hardcodes base year 2019 whereas Northwind Lease Amendment (line 51) set base year to 2021, overcharging $580.83/mo ($6,970/yr).
SQL trigger trg_work_order_badge automatically grants physical badge access when a work order is assigned to a vendor.
Chiller 1 (CH-1) controls are powered by UPS Panel B, creating a hidden single point of failure with CRAH-4.
Computer Room Air Handler 4 (CRAH-4) is powered by UPS Panel B, sharing power with CH-1.

dependencies.description: Acme Cloud Services lease contractually mandates 99.99% cooling availability with escalating SLA credit penalty tiers.
Nightly batch job executes LEASEBIL (STEP010) before BMSEXPORT (STEP020, line 66), causing billing to read yesterday's stale cooling flags.
